turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
The delivery address can be changed only until the order ships. Since it was delivered, I can’t change it. If you need help with something else, let me know.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.
I’ve verified the order, but the delivery address can be changed only until the order ships. Since this order was delivered, I can’t change it.
I do not want a return. I only want the delivery address updated after delivery.
I understand—you’re not asking for a return. The address-change policy allows changes only until an order ships, so I can’t update the address after delivery.
